description: NaNO₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one N and six O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.51 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.71 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one N atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃N tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one N atom.
